<thought>We need to find a retrosynthetic template that matches the described cyclization (intramolecular Michael addition) of a chalcone to a flavanone. The forward reaction breaks a ketone and an aromatic hydroxyl, and forms an ether oxygen, plus forms C‑C and C‑O bonds while breaking a C‑O bond. The tool requires bond specifications in a numeric format, so we will omit bond criteria and search only by functional groups broken/formed using a representative flavanone SMILES.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C1OC(Cc2ccccc2)C2=CC=CC=C12",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "aromatic hydroxyls"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ether oxygens"],
    "limit": 10
}</action_input>
